title: Close a toolbox propped open by a hammer, latch it and padlock it through its eye
instruction: Close the toolbox, fasten both latches and padlock it, then let go.
context: Locking up at the end of a job: the hammer, the last tool tossed in, landed with its handle across the front rim, so the lid sits propped open on it. It is swung round flat into the tray while the lid is held up; then the lid is shut, both latches snapped, and the open padlock's free leg threaded through the box's small padlock eye and the shackle pushed down into the body until it locks, the other hand steadying the lock.
setup: Workbench top = reference; cm from the arm-base midpoint, x forward, y left. Stanley STST1-75520 19 in toolbox (48.2 x 25.4 x 25), front face at x 27, centred, taped down, back 5.4 cm from a wall. 29 cm claw hammer: head on the tray at x 45, y -4 against a 1 cm stop block, handle straight out over the front rim, end 8 cm past the face; lid resting on it, 2.7 cm open. Latches (y +13, -13) open. Master Lock No. 5 padlock (51 x 41 x 32 mm body, 9.5 mm shackle, 24 mm between legs), open, standing at x 15, y +10. Padlock eye: bolt-on aluminium tabs (build in README), each 40 mm wide, 34 mm out, 3 mm thick, 13 mm square hole 22 mm from the face, 3 mm apart.
scoring: End photo, trial video, 2 mm feeler. Score 0 if the box moves more than 2 cm or any part of the hammer is outside the box or above its rim. Latched = latch flat over the lid's lip, feeler not entering under the lid beside it. Padlocked = shackle through both eye holes and snapped shut (a tug on the lock doesn't open it). 1.0 = both latched and padlocked; 0.5 = both latched, not padlocked; else 0. Grippers 5 cm from box and lock.
reset_notes: Unlock and remove the padlock, stand it open at its mark. Swing both latches open, open the lid, set the hammer head against its stop block with the handle straight out over the rim mark, let the lid down onto the handle. Box stays taped at its marks, 5.4 cm from the wall.
fidelity: Rigid box, fixed; lid one rigid body on the back hinge, stopped at ~50 deg by the wall. Latches: rigid hinged bodies, spring-snapped within 15 deg. Hammer: free rigid body. Padlock: rigid body at No. 5 size; shackle springs 22 mm up when open, goes down only in line, catches within 2.5 mm of home (rise and ~3 N push inside the trial lock spec in the README). Eye: deburred fixture tabs, 13 mm holes.
